sentences.text:
(Per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao) This writ petition is filed praying to grant the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Habeas Corpus directing 3rd Respondent to produce the detenue i.e., Mandanapu Subash now detained in Central Prison, Cherlapally,
Medchal-Malkajgiri District, before this Hon'ble Court and set-aside the impunged detention order passed by the 2nd Respondent vide C.No.484/ WRC/ CSB/XI/ 2021 dated 03/09/2021 and approved by the 1st Respondent as being illegal, arbitrary,
improper, unilateral, unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India and to forthwith release the Detenue and to grant..."

2. Heard Sri Pasham Trivikram Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home, appearing for the respondents.
3.

This writ petition is filed by the wife of detenue- Mandanapu Subash, challenging the detention order dated 03.09.2021 made under Section 3(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986) as confirmed by the Government vide G.O.Rt.No.2565 dated 18.11.2021.
4.

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The detenue was arrested on 19.05.2021, by the time the order of detention was passed, he was in judicial custody.
5. The order of detention refers to four crimes registered against the detenue.
Crime No.127 of 2020 was registered under Section 457 and 380 of Indian Penal Code (IPC) in Madikonda Police Station.
Crime No.109 of 2021 was registered under Section 454 and 380 of IPC in Inthezargunj Police Station.
Crime No.79 of 2021 was registered under Section 394, 454 of IPC and 102 of Code of Criminal Procedure (Cr.PC) in Geesugonda Police Station.
Crime No.115 of 2021 was registered under Section 379 of IPC in Geesugonda Police Station.

6. In all the four crimes the allegations were regarding breaking open the lock of the door,
committing theft of gold ornaments, cash.

In addition, in Crime No.79 of 2021, beating the complainant and theft of mobile phone of complainant was also alleged.
7.
All these crimes can be investigated and prosecuted in the normal course of enforcement of law and order.

By looking at the nature of all the crimes registered against the detenue, it cannot be said that the crimes would result in impacting in any manner the public order, necessitating resorting to the extreme measure of preventively detaining the detenue under the Act 1 of 1986.

sentences.text: In all such cases, this Court has been consistently holding that the order of detention is not valid in law.
This case is also similar to the decisions rendered by this Court.
Therefore, the order of detention is not sustainable and is accordingly set aside.
9. In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed.

The impugned detention order passed by the Office of the Commissioner of Police, Warangal - 2nd respondent vide C.No.484/WRC/CSB-XI/2021 dated 03.09.2021 and the consequential confirmation order of the Principal Secretary, General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order) Department, Secretariat, Hyderabad -1st respondent approving the detention vide G.O.Rt.No.2565, General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order) Department dated 18.11.2021, are hereby set aside.

entities.text: Office of the Commissioner of Police, Warangal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Mandanapu Subash, S/o. Venkanna, Age: 30 years, Caste: Munnurkapu, Occupation: Hamali, R/o. MIG 45-8-125, Keerthinagar Colony, H/o. Gorrekunta, Geesugonda Mandal, Warangal Rural District,
N/o. Pethallagadda, Garla Bayyaram Mandal of Mahabubabad District, at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
